data.name: Violet
data.gender_notes: Violet is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin viola, the violet flower. Its root is Latin viola. A Christian name used across Europe. Violet is a Latin name meaning “Violet (flower); purple”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Violet expresses “Violet (flower); purple”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Latin viola, the violet flower.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Violet total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
